# 112 Camps on the 2:00–3:00 sector — Black Rock City 2026

Camp placements are official Burning Man Project data and may be shown to users from Aug 23 12:01am (the dataset terms lift the camp-location embargo then; this release ships Aug 27). Playa Pal is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or verified by Burning Man Project.

## Abraxas Camp

**Where:** 2:15 & H · **From:** San Diego · **Landmark:** Golden Dragon art vehicle, or Abraxas mailbox · **Year:** 2026

Abraxas Dragon has been on playa since 2006, providing incredible music, art and vibes. This year is the 20th Anniversary of Abraxas! Abraxas has a history of being one of the most recognizable and photogenic art cars on the playa. We believe that art car magic can be created with dedication, commitment and basic tools and supplies. We live this dream and aspire to show burners that they can too.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/abraxasdragon/*

## ADHz

**Where:** 2:00 & H · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** 2 x 8ft fire-illuminated pillars that burst fire · **Year:** 2026

At its core, ADHz is sound sanctuary built around an Hi-Fi infra-sub audio system tuned down to 19 Hz, wrapped in a cozy & vibrant living-room vibe. DJs/Producers showcase their music through a sound system that produces frequencies which are not just heard, but deeply felt. Settle into deep bass sound baths, watch live painting unfold, or just hang and connect. Everyone is empowered to dance, listen, connect, decompress, and simply be at ADHz!

## Amateur Hour Playa Pub

**Where:** 2:00 B Plaza · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Palm tree and swing set, illuminated at night · **Year:** 2026

Welcome, dusty wanderer! Follow the sounds of clanging horseshoes and cheersing beers to cold keg-poured beer/cider and electrolyte salvation. Shaded lounge, backyard games, space for melting, mingling and a swing set for drifting. Bar runs 12—4, Mon—Fri (maybe Sat if the kegs behave). Come thirsty. Stay weird.

## Amma

**Where:** 2:00 & I · **From:** Mexico City · **Landmark:** Amma neon lights sign, flags and bedouin tent · **Year:** 2026

Meaning: "Mother", we create and hold space for everyone. This is our offering. A communal oasis. A home. A place to be curious and feel nourished. To reset and share our gifts. All are welcome. All are free. All are one.

## Après Ski Injury

**Where:** 2:00 B Plaza & B · **From:** Vienna · **Landmark:** Ski Ramp and the big "Apres Ski Injury" neon sign · **Year:** 2026

An interactive camp offering an Après-Ski Bar, a Morning Coffee Bar as well as a thrill ride: A ski ramp in the middle of the desert! Our bar is open every afternoon till late night and offers not only drinks, but entertainment, fun games and fire. You can also ski! We will have also events (see WhatWhereWhen) and ski-races.

*More: https://apresskiinjury.net/*

## Art Car Camp

**Where:** A & 2:45 · **From:** Douglas, AZ · **Landmark:** tan dome with Red lit Eagle head on top · **Year:** 2026

on Playa since 1994 a Place to gather and get your issues resolved To reunite with old friends and make new ones Gandhi's Garage for mechanical issues Barter Bob's Lost Camp Supplies for Gear Lady LaLaLa for seeing your Tomorrow Today through her many skills Catch a ride on the Mighty Zenith's little brother TV MV

## Ataraxia

**Where:** Esplanade & 2:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** 70'x14' of LED laser cut panels & ATARAXIA signs · **Year:** 2026

We're a safe space to: Chill. Laugh. Dance. Meet. Experience. Learn.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/camp_ataraxia/*

## Bag o' Dicks

**Where:** B & 2:45 · **From:** CHICAGO · **Landmark:** 3 NEON DICKS IN THE SKY · **Year:** 2026

Free-spirited camp bringing the good beats and the friendliest Bag o' Dicks you'll ever meet. Look for the giant LED dicks lighting up the sky — you truly can't miss us. A Bag o' Dicks isn't always a bad thing— come inspect our dicks and form your own highly professional opinion. Warm your dick by our bonfire most nights (and those "how is it already sunrise—" mornings too). Good vibes, questionable maturity, and zero judgment — just the way we like our dicks.

## Black Rock Disc Golf Club

**Where:** 2:00 B Plaza & B · **From:** Richmond · **Landmark:** Disc golf baskets, mushroom sculptures, blacklight · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock Disc Golf Club has a mushroom-themed disc golf course which embraces fun, games, friendly competition, collaboration, and creativity. We provide a place where folks can join together and throw one of the custom stamped discs loaned out at the camp. You can win one at one of our tournaments or events! The course is accessible 24/7, and discs glow in the dark so don't hesitate to swing by late night/early morning for a round. We also have some mushroom hazards on the course! We have tall ones, small ones, ones that glow, and ones that show you what disc golf is all about. It's definitely a psychedelic experience to walk through, even if you aren't in the mood to play a round. Just make sure to listen for the call of, "FORE!"

*More: https://www.facebook.com/groups/blackrockcitydiscgolf/*

## Black Rock Labs The Expanse

**Where:** H & 2:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Large white banners with Black Rock Labs symbol · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock Labs is a Civic Support camp focused on testing/scaling/messaging climate smart regenerative technologies at Black Rock City and the Regionals. Black Rock Labs hosts 1-hour Sustainability Talk Series at 2 pm on Tuesday/Wednesday/Friday and a Playa-wide tour on the Abraxas art car at 4 pm on Thursday to view BRC's expanding deployment of renewables and regenerative climate smart activities.

## Blood & Sugar

**Where:** F & 2:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Red Blood & Sugar banner with warm string lights. · **Year:** 2026

A mildly chaotic clubhouse dedicated to the strange art of keeping humans functioning with a little help from treats, movement, and friends. Stop by for Bloody Mary mornings, gummy bears, yoga, and conversations that range from heartfelt to weird to unhinged. This space celebrates resilience, curiosity, and mutual support. Wander in and help us keep things balanced.

## Bo_b Squad

**Where:** 2:00 & 2:00 B Plaza · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Couch Swings, Tree of Exhaustion, Nuclear Bombs · **Year:** 2026

The 'Bo_b Squad' is a rag tag group of nuclear clowns specializing in atomic hijinx. The crew is committed to providing nuclear warmth to the Playa via the custom burn barrels 'Fat Man' and 'Little Boy'. If comfort is what you're looking for then the Squad's couch swings were made for you. The 'Bo_b Squad' hopes to see you in the cosmic wastes.

## Camp Blowjob

**Where:** F & 2:45 · **From:** Boise · **Landmark:** Pink and yellow blowjob mural wall · **Year:** 2026

Camp Blowjob is where you can let loose and get your leaf blown at Burning Man in a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! We aim to provide a fun atmosphere where all are welcome!

## Camp BUI

**Where:** B & 2:45 · **From:** Medford · **Landmark:** Large lighted banner with name and logo · **Year:** 2026

The friendliest camp on the playa famous for our front porch. Drop by for a visit and a cold drink. Join us at sundown for a Shot of the Day or Thursday from 2:00 to 4:00pm for our Pineapple Upside Down Cake Thursday event. We are well known for our fine cuisine and repartee.

*More: https://www.campbui.org*

## Camp Cohere

**Where:** D & 2:15 · **From:** Tahoe City, CA · **Landmark:** white moroccan tent with camp cohere sign · **Year:** 2026

A group of long-time burners who are committed to fostering human connection on the playa

## Camp Delicioso & Creperie

**Where:** C & 2:15 · **From:** Long Beach · **Landmark:** Giant RED Lampshade that towers over 15ft · **Year:** 2026

Hungry! Hung over? You've been hankerin' for something warm in your belly? Swing on by Camp Delicioso and Crêperie, where you'll find an International collective of foodies who'll entertain and serve you the best damn OG French crêpe in Black Rock City. EST 2007 We've got sweet and savory flavors that'll satisfy even the most discerning Playa palate. And while the crêpes are cooking, and the coffee is grinding, we'll serve up a saucy dance music set too! 9ish to noonish Tue, Wed and Thu. If you miss us giving you crêpe, come on over anyway. We have various events happening throughout the week Tue - Fri.

*More: https://campdelicioso.com*

## Camp Fly

**Where:** C & 2:45 · **From:** Denver · **Landmark:** Red Pickleball court · **Year:** 2026

Camp Fly is the home of our insect themed art cars. Swing by our camp to get a ride, or reach out if you would like us to help host your event. At our camp, we have a pickleball court and an aerial silks rig, on which we will be offering aerial silks performances and lessons, please come find us!

*More: https://campflyburningman.github.io/Web-Page/Camp-Fly-Preview.html*

## Camp LandHO!

**Where:** 2:00 & E · **From:** Zephyr Cove, NV · **Landmark:** a front yard built from boats and sails · **Year:** 2026

Sunburnt, mischievous, and gently naughty-cal - a low-rise harbor on the playa where art cars dock, the lighthouse winks, and a sound trailer keeps the night humming. Come for Christina, our flagship mutant vehicle, and stay for Port Hours: predictable hosting windows with tea, small gifts, hands-on demos and low-barrier skill shares. At night the lighthouse and sound trailer host a rotating cast of top DJs, guest selectors and local talent playing flow-based sets that fold into layered vessel decks and late-night flow. We run on participation, consent, radical inclusion and Leave No Trace - builders, DJs and apprentices co-create a playful port of call where mischief is choreographed with care.

*More: https://daydreamfamily.group/land-ho*

## Camp Peace of Ass

**Where:** C & 2:45 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** 4 large circular road mirrors · **Year:** 2026

Povides the "professional installation" of lusciously, unique, "Peace of Ass" bike seat covers, bringing "Peace to the Playa, One Dusty Bottom at a Time." We continue to service the lovely citizens of Black Rock City who make their way to our inviting camp. We encourage our customers, with humor, to check out the Wall of Mirrors, and write on our annual poster. We also offer an "Ask the Expert" advice table as a "pop-up" activity.

## Camp Questionmark

**Where:** Esplanade & 2:00 · **From:** West Coast · **Landmark:** Question Marks · **Year:** 2026

The age of questioning is here! Celebrating creativity & music born from the playa. Bring us your questions and we will give you more back )?(

*More: http://campquestionmark.com*

## Camp Random Pants

**Where:** 2:30 & E · **From:** West Coast · **Landmark:** Large dome with pants! · **Year:** 2026

Need pants? We got you! Take a pair or leave a pair. Relax in our Dome, grab a drink from the bar and enjoy some tunes. Come by for our 10am morning yodel and mimosa social!

## Camp Reno Nation

**Where:** C & 2:15 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Reno Nation arch · **Year:** 2026

Biggest Little Shit Show On The Playa Great beer; Weird People Welcome to the Shit-Rock Saloon V3!

*More: https://www.instagram.com/reno_nation*

## Camp Stranger Things

**Where:** B & 2:45 · **From:** Bozeman, Montana · **Landmark:** Camp Stranger Things sign · **Year:** 2026

Bringing our strange art to playa since 2019. If you are looking for us, you just found us. Check out the map and look for our art out on playa, A Cosmos Within. Come by and say Hello if you love what we do.

## Camp Summer Camp

**Where:** E & 2:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** bedazzled 'Camp Summer Camp' sign · **Year:** 2026

We are a San Francisco-based camp that celebrates the whimsical spirit of Summer Camp. We want to revisit the connection, growth, and playful wonder that comes with those magical childhood weeks. Think back to those golden days of campfire singalongs, friendship bracelets, and endless play?our mission is to teleport you right back to that delightful, wonder-filled time of your youth, but reimagined on the Playa.

## Camp Zoombox

**Where:** 2:15 & F · **From:** Boise · **Landmark:** Large ZOOMBOX sign · **Year:** 2026

A giant boombox and some rad people

## Charting the Uncharted

**Where:** A & 2:45 · **From:** Tulsa · **Landmark:** Charting the Uncharted flag · **Year:** 2026

Charting the Uncharted is an Oklahoma-based camp of first-time Burners supporting our interactive art installation, The Witness Wall. We invite participants to share their stories through writing and audio, creating a living map of human medial experience. Rooted in curiosity, connection, and contribution, our camp is dedicated to exploration - of both the desert and the voices within it.

## Chicago Handshake

**Where:** D & 2:45 · **From:** Chicago · **Landmark:** "Chicago Handshake" signage · **Year:** 2026

Craving a drink from Chicago or need some shade for your head? Look no further than Chicago Handshake, where you can grab a shot and a beer(The Chicago Handshake) or find a hat on our hat shack to protect you from the blistering sun. We also take sunrise and sunset videos of art on the playa.

*More: https://untitledtitle.com*

## Chivo Loco

**Where:** D & 2:15 · **From:** Miami · **Landmark:** Chivo Loco Flag · **Year:** 2026

A vibrant community bringing flavor, music, and warmth to Playa. Sharing our culture through food and connection. Our chill lounge offers a welcoming space with good vibes and great conversations. Everyone is invited to stop by, enjoy a meal, and experience our hospitality. Come as you are?leave as part of the Chivo Loco family!

## Coming Home

**Where:** D & 2:45 · **From:** Carson City · **Landmark:** wooden circle on top of our white RV · **Year:** 2026

Art Installation "Coming Home"

*More: http://Lambinarts.com*

## COOLSVILLE

**Where:** A & 2:15 · **From:** Coolsville, USA · **Landmark:** Large glowing wave structure or comfy living room! · **Year:** 2026

An art support camp made up of builders, fabricators, and artists who come to Black Rock City to help bring projects to life. Many camp members are involved in Honoraria or placed art installations, and the camp functions as a home base for people spending most of their time working on art across the city. Our street frontage includes a few small interactive elements including Rat Trap, a playful bar cart with a giant mousetrap, The Wave, a light up sculptural wave that people can step into, and The Living Room, a cozy listening space on playa with a rug, vintage couch, lamps, and a hi fi stereo playing an eclectic mix of music. We're fun! Come hang out at COOLSVILLE

## Cuddle Oasis

**Where:** Esplanade & 2:30 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** 4 large Palm Trees and Cuddle Oasis flags · **Year:** 2026

Too hot? Too Cold? Partied out? Need a break? Need a cuddle or two? or Ten? You have come to the right place! Come relax under our many shade structures. Enjoy afternoon Sound baths. Come by after a night of parting on the Playa and relax on our rugs to healing electronic sounds. Follow the large lighted Palm trees at night and come enjoy a drink at the bar and ask about our daily activities.

## Daydream

**Where:** E & 2:15 · **From:** Lake Tahoe · **Landmark:** The Dream Lounge · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Daydream, a sanctuary in Black Rock City designed for radical inclusion, creativity, and connection. Step into our Dreamers' Lounge, an immersive space to relax, recharge, and meet fellow Burners away from the chaos of the playa. Start your mornings at our coffee bar and interactive talks, then linger in the lounge or cuddle puddle for spontaneous social and creative interactions. In the afternoons, join intimate workshops and reflective activities that spark inspiration. As the sun sets, our lounge comes alive with ambient projection art, creating a visually immersive experience. Daydream is a place to dream, connect, and embrace transformation together.

*More: https://www.daydreamfamily.group*

## Deoxidized

**Where:** 2:00 & D · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** 30 ft green tent, with Deoxidized sign in front · **Year:** 2026

We are a global community of artists, builders, entrepreneurs, and explorers who come together to create a welcoming neighborhood on the playa. Our theme, the Global Neighborhood Oasis, reflects our belief that connection and participation are at the heart of Black Rock City. By day, we host our Soul Series in our shaded Oasis with guided talks, workshops, and reflective experiences. By night, our bar opens, and music, dancing, and celebration bring the neighborhood together under our glowing parachute. Stop in for conversation, shade, or a moment of inspiration and connection!

*More: https://deoxidizedcamp.org*

## Desert Dragon

**Where:** 2:00 & G · **From:** Los Angeles, CA · **Landmark:** large dragon head stage, pink lasers and lights · **Year:** 2026

Pink Dragon is a dragon themed sound camp centered around a large Dragon Head DJ stage that brings together art, music, and nightlife in Black Rock City. Our frontage features nightly DJs, a shaded dance floor, immersive lighting, lasers, and flame effects, creating a high energy space for participants to gather and dance. In front of the stage, our 24 hour lounge offers soft seating and non alcoholic dragon themed drinks, giving people a place to relax, connect, and enjoy the vibe. Pink Dragon is all about great music, a striking dragon stage, and a welcoming atmosphere.

*More: https://www.pinkdragoncamp.com/*

## Discosmos

**Where:** 2:00 & K · **From:** Mexico City · **Landmark:** Giant light tower shinning in the horizon · **Year:** 2026

tired of having fun in the sun? take a momento for downtempo. come chill with us at Malio's, the bar with the best view on the playa

## Discotique Pancake Boutique

**Where:** 2:00 & G · **From:** Vancouver, BC · **Landmark:** 20 feet bright yellow & red cube · **Year:** 2026

The most sizzling spot on the Playa, serving up a symphony of pancakes Sunday to Saturday from 10AM-4PM daily along with Live Music, Open-Bar and a chill lounge with classes and workshops. Bring your plate and dancing shoes and let's get this pancake party flipping!

*More: https://discotique.org*

## Dragon Axis Disco

**Where:** D & 2:45 · **Landmark:** double-decker school bus with light · **Year:** 2026

## Dune Dwellers

**Where:** E & 2:45 · **From:** Ogden · **Landmark:** "The Wandering Playhouse parking" Sign · **Year:** 2026

Mutant Vehicle Support Camp for The Wandering Playhouse

## Edna's Oasis

**Where:** E & 2:15 · **From:** Truckee · **Landmark:** Edna the Elephant and the container with cat mural · **Year:** 2026

Edna's Oasis, where the elephants instinctively flock like the bassheads of capastrano. Feel the rumble of every step. But be cautious because she is a B.I.T.C.H.

## Firelight & Lemonade

**Where:** D & 2:45 · **From:** Eugene and Bend, Oregon, and California · **Landmark:** Large lemonade stand, yellow banners and flags. · **Year:** 2026

Firelight and Lemonade is a welcoming oasis where you can cool down with cold lemonade, warm up by the fire, and connect with others. Stop by to pause, reflect, recharge, and share conversation.

## For the Glory of The C Ship

**Where:** 2:15 & G · **From:** Ukiah · **Landmark:** The Crystal Ship glowing green · **Year:** 2026

*More: https://thecrystalshipartcar.net/*

## Foreskin

**Where:** C & 2:45 · **From:** Brooklyn · **Landmark:** Our sign cloth outside · **Year:** 2026

Camp Foreskin... not what you're thinking! We provide facials throughout the week For Your Skin! Great group of people just wanting to give back to our community. Come chill with us anytime and you might be in for a skin-gasm.

## French Maid Brigade

**Where:** A & 2:45 · **From:** Santa Cruz, CA · **Landmark:** Red Room Lounge fronting the street - red lights · **Year:** 2026

The French Maids are a playful, meaningful, health and wellness camp that is excited to offer Ayurvedic Massages, Scented Oils, Yoga, Breathing, Happiness and Art workshops to express any Burners creative skills...Come chill and add to your experience on playa with the MAIDS!

## FUN-DO BAR

**Where:** D & 2:45 · **From:** Lake Tahoe · **Landmark:** Yellow/Blue Serving Bar labeled with FUN-DO BAR · **Year:** 2026

Looking to get melty while having a booty shaking good time?! Look no further than Fun-Do Bar! Our delicious Swiss cheese and chocolate fondue paired with ice cold wine is sure to make your taste buds dance! Join us for our dance party happy hour (4p-6p or until we run out!). Our servers will be scantily clad wearing nothing but aprons, so come on down and melt with happiness while shaking your booty to the beats! Soup Sluts will be serving two nights of soup magic for thirsty and hungry Burners. Night 1 (Tues 10p-12a) will be vegan pozole- spiced sauteed jackfruit and hominy, topped with cilantro and lime juice. Night 2 (Thurs 10p-12a) will be vegan tom kha soup. Nothing like a spicy, hearty and delicious soup to help rejuvenate people for their night out.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/fundobar/*

## Fusion Valley

**Where:** 2:30 & B · **From:** Gerlach · **Landmark:** An atom shaped lit sign and rooftop screen · **Year:** 2026

Fusion Valley, founded in 1999, is a long-running playa living room where sweet and slightly surly geeks and artists gather in the dust. Stop by to cool off in our shade, play board games, charge up, weave through our human slalom course, or grab the mic during a pop-up radio moment. By night, roll up to our drive-in for delightfully questionable cinema. Come for the mischief, stay for the connection.

*More: https://fusionvalley.net/*

## Gianni's Fellas

**Where:** C & 2:15 · **Landmark:** Italian Flag, Camp Name Sign and Camp Founder Flag · **Year:** 2026

## Guano Loco Lounge

**Where:** B & 2:15 · **From:** Grand Junction · **Landmark:** Large black rectangle shade structure, neon sign · **Year:** 2026

We are a sanctuary for those who embrace the mystique of the winged wonders that navigate the darkness. Take a break from the stimulation of BRC with a visit to our Bat Cave, a sensory deprivation experience featuring sound blocking headphones and inversion tables inside a cooling cave environment. "Hang out" in our lounge equipped with surround sound, moody lighting, and espresso martinis for 21+ Burners. We encourage a sense of unity and Radical Inclusion. Sane or Bat Shit Crazy, with wings or without, it doesn't matter to us. All creatures are welcome in our colony.

## Halloween Town BRC

**Where:** H & 2:15 · **From:** Rosemead · **Landmark:** Light-up plastic jack o'lanterns · **Year:** 2026

## HARDLY

**Where:** Esplanade & 2:45 · **From:** Mountain View · **Landmark:** Big Red H Beacon 45 feet in the air · **Year:** 2026

## Hot Stuff

**Where:** 2:00 & F · **From:** London / NYC / Berlin · **Landmark:** Large suspended Chili LED scultpure · **Year:** 2026

Drinks served from dawn onward for the thirsty traveler crossing the desert sands. All manner of chilli hot and ice cool refreshments will be on offer accompanied by music from storied DJs from across the savage sands.

## Imagine Nation Art Lounge

**Where:** 2:00 B Plaza · **From:** Kramatorsk, Ukraine · **Landmark:** Tractor Trailer Truck with blue and white flags. · **Year:** 2026

Remember how you felt when you were drawing on kitchen tables and living room floors? Tap back into a state of mind that embodied the purist creative version of yourself! We encourage our guests to tap into their childhood imagination again through the medium of art, especially drawing and colouring.

## Intergalactic

**Where:** 2:15 & F · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** GJ fleet of Art Cars + Vinyl Bar Neon Sign · **Year:** 2026

## Jitters & Bitters

**Where:** E & 2:45 · **Landmark:** Jitters & Bitters chalk sign! · **Year:** 2026

We will be serving cold brew with milk and dairy alternatives and ice! Hangout space in the shade with chairs provided to get out of the sun and get jittery. Service is in the morning and we will have 1 midnight brew session to help stay up until the sunrise!

## Johnny Tacomas at The Last Resort

**Where:** 2:30 & K · **From:** Tacoma · **Landmark:** Arcade themed booth, 20 ft tall white trailer · **Year:** 2026

Here at The Last Resort motel we pride ourselves on our 5 star attitude and 1 star accommodations. Busted shoe? Empty stomach? Flat tires? Tired hoofs? Take a load off! We might possibly have what you need. Please take a number, have a seat, and someone will be with you shortly. You can grab a bite at our playa renowned flagship diner, Johnny Tacomas. The menu changes hourly to offer a unique and unpredictable dining experience. When we're not at the desk, you can catch us cruising on Inky, Clyde, or Pacman, floating through the night like ghosts in hot pursuit. If you see us glowing in the distance, chase us down and hop on before we vanish into the maze of the Playa!

## Kinky Pizza

**Where:** 2:30 & D · **From:** San Mateo · **Landmark:** Kinky Pizza LED lit sign · **Year:** 2026

Hot slices, Hot flogging, and Hot fire. It's only kinky the first time...

*More: https://www.instagram.com/playa_pizza_portage*

## Kombuchachacha

**Where:** D & 2:45 · **From:** Menlo Park · **Landmark:** tall red and black flags flanking our sign · **Year:** 2026

Kombucha: (n) kom-BOO-cha. Renowned playa aphrodisiac. You may not get the booch you want but you will definitely get the booch you need. Cha Cha: (n) Intricate Latin American dance. The home of con+sent. Come meet our chicken(s). Relax, refresh and cha cha the day away. 4 stars on yelp 2025.

## Kosmic Korner

**Where:** 2:30 & A · **Landmark:** 7' Tall "Kosmic Korner" LED Sign · **Year:** 2026

## Lit AF

**Where:** A & 2:45 · **From:** Las Vegas · **Landmark:** 10 foot LED sign with lightning bolt + sun rays · **Year:** 2026

Stumbling around the playa in the dark like a total darkwad? Come get Lit AF! We'll help you add fairy lights to your bike, backpack, or outfit. Stop by for a workshop, spare batteries (AA or CR2032), or to donate extra lights or batteries to the cause. And if you need lights while you're out and about, our Darkwad Patrol may just find you and save your poor darkwad soul.

*More: https://camplitaf.com*

## Live Laugh Love Lounge

**Where:** K & 2:15 · **From:** Bombay Beach, CA · **Landmark:** illuminated "Live, Laugh, Love" Art Wall · **Year:** 2026

Step into the most relatable sanctuary in Black Rock City. We are a high-irony, low-stress retreat celebrating the simple comforts of suburban life with a massive gallery of reclaimed domestic art. Visitors can enjoy a nostalgic backyard experience featuring classic lawn games like cornhole and ladder toss. Come for the snacks, stay for the board games, and find your inner peace at our signature wall of wisdom. It is the perfect place to take a break from the extra and embrace the basic.

## Loadie Camp

**Where:** A & 2:15 · **From:** Arlington · **Landmark:** Clearly marked Loadie Camp Bar facing the street · **Year:** 2026

The home of the iconic Shark Car. Loadie Camp is a hive of Mutant Vehicle visionaries and builders, contributing over 10 different Mutant Vehicles of varying sizes. Come meet the builders and learn more about the Mutant Vehicle process.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/groups/144861568869094/*

## Lookout! The Camp

**Where:** D & 2:45 · **From:** Portland · **Landmark:** Wood and metal "Lookout!" sign · **Year:** 2026

Absurdity disguised as a fire extinguisher. The art support camp for "Lookout!"

*More: http://firelookout26.com*

## Lost and Sound

**Where:** F & 2:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** cozy living room space with compasses at entrance · **Year:** 2026

A cozy neighborhood space, welcoming everyone to immerse themselves in the spirit of discovery and togetherness. Engage with our interactive art installations that narrate the tales of artifacts from forgotten times. Every corner holds a secret, and every artifact is a key to new connections. Share your story of what you found, the journey it took you on, and watch as we create a cocktail (or mocktail based on your preference) that embodies the spirit of your adventure. We welcome you to explore, relax and rejuvenate with communal conversation. Our intimate dance floor beckons you to let loose and find your rhythm. Come, explore, and leave your mark on our ever-evolving story.

## Martha Love

**Where:** D & 2:45 · **Landmark:** Martha Love Sign · **Year:** 2026

Come play out fabulous games Performance Stage BRC Community space - Stage available for your use - Come and have your presentation in our space. contact us to make a reservation Martha - Historical Vehicle - Longest continuous art car on the playa . Sharing Love; Jump on board and enjoy the loving company, visit the artists, and the best beats in Black Rock

## Matcha Mama

**Where:** 2:30 & E · **From:** Manhattan · **Landmark:** Green-lit matcha bar with Matcha Mama sign · **Year:** 2026

A daytime oasis serving handcrafted matcha lattes and meaningful connection. Stop by for a refreshing drink made to order, then settle into our shaded "Spill the Tea" lounge for conversation, reflection, or simply a moment of rest. With rotating flavors and a calm, welcoming atmosphere, this is a space to slow down and be present. Whether you stay briefly or linger a while, you're invited to connect in whatever way feels right.

## METAL MIMI Camp

**Where:** 2:30 & A · **From:** Boulder · **Landmark:** Metal Mimi Sign · **Year:** 2026

Metal Mimi, the curious little creature who is our namesake, dwells at the Bay Area Metal Shop where Art Destined for the Playa is Born. Metal Mimi is Witness to Art made Manifest and she is the Keeper of our Magical Dreams. Metal Mimi Camp was created in honor of the Metal Workers, Welders, and Artists who desire to bring their Art to the Dust. Our mission is to help them. You will find their art at Metal Mimi Camp and on Playa.
